$comment: Expectations drafted with `pnpm packs:truth` and reviewed by hand on 2026-10-14, before the pack was scored. Pure insertions (dataCollection blocks, beforeSendLog) are the decisions each repository made, not sites; comment lines that changed with an option are part of that option's site. See ../sentry/RESEARCH.md. Entries from Pokedex on were drafted and reviewed the same way on 2026-10-16 (UPT-64), before the pack was scored with them. silent (UPT-123): each Sentry.init that left dataCollection unset with sendDefaultPii unset or false, read from its upgrade's diff on 2026-10-19 after the record was written: required where the upgrade set a restrictive dataCollection there to keep v10's collection (moved files and imported constants included), product-choice where it upgraded the init and accepted v11's defaults.

repos.why: Astro site with one Sentry.init passing sendDefaultPii: false and enableLogs: false. Upgrade a6ccab10af9897de8844d1b6ecf17154faf5de9e keeps v10 privacy with an explicit dataCollection and replaces enableLogs: false with beforeSendLog: () => null. TS2353 reports only the first excess property of the literal, so enableLogs has no diagnostic.

findings.note: TS2353 sendDefaultPii; the comment line 16 above it changed with it.
enableLogs: false (lines 20-23 are its comment); replaced by beforeSendLog: () => null.

repos.why: Django app with a Vite/TypeScript frontend; its root tsconfig.json has files: [] and project references, so the truth helper compiled nothing and the site comes from the upgrade commit alone. Merge f0716c561da6818e065ad49050ea076401df0741 (other dependency bumps in it are not Sentry's).

findings.note: sendDefaultPii: true replaced by dataCollection: { userInfo: true }.

repos.why: Static site; sendDefaultPii: false replaced by dataCollection, attachStacktrace: false added in the same init (part of that change). Upgrade 3919a76399085c6c393b00d3a5413cf395ad1e55; the test asserting the init options follows the source change.

Web client; sendDefaultPii replaced by dataCollection and enableLogs: true removed from the same init. TS2353 reports only the first excess property, so enableLogs has no diagnostic. TypeScript 7.0.2 in the repository; compiled with this checkout's 5.9.3. Upgrade 4df8d7d64c764bb76b4c17cc7a1a7814bb1c5315.

The Godot SDK's web bridge on @sentry/browser, @sentry/core and @sentry/wasm, moved together by upgrade 1b67a2377c64643025889fb1dd0dc744035ea907. sendDefaultPii is passed through an any-typed options object (no diagnostic); breadcrumbsIntegration({ console }) is TS2353; beforeSendTransaction moves under traceLifecycle static; Scope.clear() is gone (TS2339). test.js (plain JS, outside the program) renames spanToStreamedSpanJSON to spanToJSON and reads the span through getActiveSpan, since ScopeData has no span in @sentry/core 11. Retyping options from any to BrowserOptions (and the orgId, beforeSend annotations it needed) compiles under v10 as well: the repository's cleanup, not sites; the import edits feed getMainCarrier and DataCollection.

findings.note: TS2353 console: false; the Console integration is excluded by name instead.
Lines 261-277: kept only under traceLifecycle static.
TS2339 Scope.clear(); comment lines 307-311 above changed with it.
Lines 468-470: getScopeData().span, which @sentry/core 11 ScopeData no longer has.
